review:
Samurai Code is a 5x4 Japanese warrior slot with female samurai and treasure chests. Fish act as regular symbols in the base game but become money symbols in the bonus.

Three or more scatters award up to 20 free spins. In the bonus, money symbols carry random values from 2x to 2,000x, and male samurai act as wilds and collectors of the cash. Every four collected wilds award 10 more spins and a growing win multiplier starting at 2x. The RTP is 96.08%. It's the Big Bass formula in a samurai setting.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
